reviews.t: One of the best masks I’ve used!!!!!

I used it for the first time today and it is the most delicious nurturing softening silky mask I have ever used and I have spent $75 on some 4 ounce jars of high end masks. This one is the bomb!!!! I will be buying it holiday

reviews.t: Omg! Where have you been all my 3C high porosity life???
reviews.x: I don't even know where to begin, so I'll start with my hair. New Natural, just did a big chop, extremely dry, high porosity, 3c (sometimes 4a mix) type hair. I've tried so many products to gain and maintain moisture for my curls and I've wasted so much money trying multiple products for the result I got from this 1 product. It has a really nice fragrance too. I color my hair and it has not affected the color at all.  Will continue to use and recommend this product.

Love love love. I tried a sample from Sally’s and almost instantly purchased this on Amazon. It’s a bit cheaper on here than going to the store. The product doesn’t leave hair greasy and I use it almost daily.

I really like the way this product works in that it moisturizes my hair and leaves it soft and shiny.  It's not the least bit oily.  I waited awhile to use it because I bought it on a whim and then didn't like the name because it sounded like food.  I was also concerned because it is green and my hair is blonde.  However, once I tried it,  I found that it's the best conditioner/mask for hair I've  used and I've tried some. Also, it doesn't change my hair color at all.  It goes a long way, too.

reviews.t: One of My Favorite Hair Conditioners!
reviews.x: I have natural curly, frizzy hair.  About a year ago I was at a local beauty supply store.  A customer in the store was buying some SAUCE BEAUTY Guacamole Whip Hair Mask.  She told the clerk at the register that this is the best conditioner she has ever used.  So, I then asked the clerk at the register about it.  She told me that they can hardly keep this stuff in stock.  It disappears the day that they put it on the shelf.  Since there was only one left, I decided to buy it and try it.  It has

I’ve used this twice (the first picture from the first use, the second from next use) and already love it! I work at a pool and the chlorine has damaged and dried my hair quite a bit but this has already started restoring the moisture in it! After one use, my hair was already soft while still wet! It also smells AMAZING. I would definitely recommend this.

reviews.t: Great value, makes my hair super soft
reviews.x: I have very finely textured hair that damages easily, but looks oily if I use a heavy conditioner. My go-to conditioner is Bumble and Bumble Seaweed  But after getting my hair colored or highlighted it needs some extra conditioning or it really feels like straw. This mask works!  I was hoping for a treatment that had longer-term conditioning (2-4 washes) but you get so much mask in this jar that I don't mind using it every wash, or every other wash. It rinses clean but gets rid of the straw feel

This is the only product that has helped me out since I super damaged my hair with bleaching! I use this product daily and even diluted it to spray as a leave-in! My step-daughter has curly hair that was so hard to manage and now I use it for her too! This stuff is a literal miracle! I love it so much!

reviews.t: I finally found a conditioner that works for me!
reviews.x: My hair has been highlighted for decades. I have blonde, straight fine hair.  I flip flop from long and short styles. I've always been annoyed that my ends look stringy and dried out. I've tried several deep conditioners and they either have been too heavy for my hair or just not effective. I tried this and I love it. When I rinsed out the conditioner it had a much different feel from others that I've used. It rinsed out cleaner without that slippery oily feel and the blow dry kept it smooth and

This is the holy grail of hair products. Not only does it smell absolutely amazing but it gave life to my severely damaged hair.  I recently did a box of color oops, bleach 3x and toned 3x to achieve a silver blonde. Needless to say it severely damaged my hair leaving it almost straw like.  One treatment of this miracle product and my hair was silky smooth and soft. Even after a couple washes it remained soft and almost as if I never damaged it.  I love the entire SAUCE line. Even the detangler

I used this for the first time tonight after receiving it yesterday and I love it. My hair has recently been bleached but most importantly it was over processed, so when my hair is wet it feels soggy, stringy, and like elastic. After using the mask I can already feel a difference, I can actually run my fingers through my hair. This was a good addition to my hair routine and i’ll definitely be buying it again. I’ll definitely check out their other products.

Started using this product on my 3b-3c curly hair and at the same time was noticing dryness when i came out of the shower after using it. it started to make my hair really fried on the top layer and i read the ingredients to see what was up. third ingredient is dimethicone. a silicon, which is known for drying out hair. basically i’m pissed, it’s going in the trash, and i’ll be making sure my curlfriends don’t use this product.

My hair is very dry, unmanageable, fine, and curly. This product really made it shiny and soft. Even before I straightened it, my curls were smoother than they’ve been in a really long time. If you’re looking organic though, this is not it. I thought it was based on the name but should have looked at the ingredients first. Either way it’s amazing.
This product is so amazing especially for the price. I put it in my hair and slept on it over night. I washed it out the next morning and my hair was soooo silky and smooth. Definitely recommend!
Out of all the hair masks I’ve used, this is by far the best one. Keeps your hair soft, hydrated, and full of volume. And it smells amazing!!

I absolutely love this deep conditioner! A little over a year ago my hair was going through some dryness and I had no idea what was causing it. I used all of the deep conditioners I already had in my bathroom, from OGX to Shea Moisture and my hair still felt the same.
